# devcontainer-airlock

> Secure, layered devcontainers for AI coding agents: a workbench per agent
> with no GitHub token and no ssh key, isolated containers with no network
> for hooks, tests and installs, and a broker and an egress proxy beside them.
> Rootless podman.
> Apache License 2.0. Author: Ivan Pinatti (https://github.com/ivan-pinatti).
> Canonical repository: https://github.com/ivan-pinatti-labs/devcontainer-airlock

## What it does

Splits a development environment for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) into
layers by what each one is trusted with. Each agent works in a workbench of
its own that holds no GitHub token, no ssh key and no other agent's login.
Hooks, tests, package installs and throwaway binaries run in L2 containers
with only the working tree, no network and no credentials. A GitHub broker
holds the token and runs an allowlist of gh commands, an ssh-agent holds the
key, and an egress proxy per workspace allows only the services a project
names. Images are built, linted and scanned in CI, published to the GitHub
Container Registry as `airlock-<name>`, and consumed by digest.
[docs/LAYERS.md](docs/LAYERS.md) is the reference.

## Key files

- [README.md](README.md): Pitch, quickstart, and usage
- [docs/LAYERS.md](docs/LAYERS.md): The layers, what is a boundary and what is policy, daily use
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Instructions for AI coding agents and contributors,
  imported by [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md)
- [docs/MERGE_PIPELINE.md](docs/MERGE_PIPELINE.md): How a pull request gets
  from opened to merged here
- [.pre-commit-config.yaml](.pre-commit-config.yaml): The checklists and
  hooks every change runs through

## Tech stack

- Container images built and run with Podman (rootless), Docker compatible
- GitHub Actions for building, scanning, signing and publishing to GHCR
- pre-commit, hadolint, gitleaks and Trivy for the local and CI checks

## Conventions

- Conventional Commits for commit messages, no ticket prefix baked in
- pre-commit hooks wired up via
  [ivan-pinatti-labs/pre-commit-checklists](https://github.com/ivan-pinatti-labs/pre-commit-checklists),
  see [.pre-commit-config.yaml](.pre-commit-config.yaml)
